summary: Frontend-only check of the 3 follow-up fixes from iteration_126, plus a regression run of the Phase 1 path, at 390x844 on QA attempt 8d2bae3d (JEE Main PYQ 21 Jan 2026 S2, not submitted). FU1 PASS: when the answer PUT returns 520, player-save-label shows '1 pending' and player-save-note shows 'Safe on phone · sending' in full (scrollWidth 118 = clientWidth 118, right edge 186px, timer starts at 194px). player-error shows the exact safe text and the page has no 'Cloudflare' text. After unroute the label shows 'Saved' in about 5 s and the note and error go away. Offline (context.set_offline) shows 'Offline' with the note '1 safe on phone', which also fits, then 'Saved' about 7 s after coming back online. FU2 PASS: making each asset GET fail with 520 twice gave requests at 7.2 s, 9.2 s (+2 s) and 14.2 s (+5 s). question-image-1-0-retrying ('Picture is taking longer · trying again') showed at 9.4 s, the bitmap loaded at 15.2 s, no error box appeared, and the number tiles stayed tappable while loading. The try counter reset (AssetImage.tsx:27) is correct by code reading. FU3 PASS by code reading only (Pieces.tsx:32-33): PYQ papers have no cut-piece options and no mock with pieces can be reached. REGRESSION PASS: /pyq shows '30 PAPERS AVAILABLE', the attempt opens, the question picture loads, and the selected tile is green (border rgb(74,222,128) 2px, background rgb(242,251,245), tick circle rgb(22,163,74) with white tick, aria-label ends with ', selected'). Saves end on 'Saved'. Every test answer was cleared afterwards (footer '0 answered'). Submit was blocked by a route abort and was never called.

issues: Minor: the player-save-note line only shows while saves are pending, so the header grows by about 12px and the content below moves down a little when a save fails or the phone goes offline. Optional fix: keep the space for the line reserved.

action_items: Optional (cosmetic): in useImageRetry the `attempt` value is never reset after a successful load. If the same picture is invalidated later (for example after a grant renewal), its loading box shows 'trying again' at once, before any failure. A `retrying` flag that clears on success would fix this (src/components/AssetImage.tsx:23-27,74; src/components/Pieces.tsx:32-33).
Optional: on very narrow cut-piece boxes, 'trying again…' (10.5px, one line) will be cut off with an ellipsis. This is acceptable as it is.
critical_code_review_comments: AssetImage.tsx:27 resets tries.current when the value arrives, so a later failure gets the full 2/5/10/20/30 s schedule again. Confirmed by code reading. At runtime the first two delays (2 s, 5 s) were observed.

Pieces.tsx:32-33 shows '<id>-retrying' only when attempt > 0 and the box height is at least 16px. The text first appears when the first automatic retry starts (about 2 s after the first failure), not at the moment of the failure. The same is true of AssetImage.
